plain: The opening statement that explains the purpose of a law or document

webster.text: Something previous; introduction to a discourse or writing.

more.text: The introductory part of a statute, which states the reasons and intent of the law.

example.quote: A preamble usually contains the general motives or reason for the particular regulations or measures which follow it, and is always understood to be explained and limited by them.
example.cite: James Madison, Report on the Virginia Resolutions (Report of 1800), Jan. 7, 1800
